task_definition.task_description: Please check whether the Sony XM5 headphones are in stock, then hold the best recommendation for me and confirm that held order, add that confirmed selection to a cart, and generate an invoice with the best discount using my email and Stripe. After that, save a short purchase and invoice summary note, get the latest business news, then email me that note with the subject that my order has been processed, and finally analyze the note text.

user_input.query: Please check whether the Sony XM5 headphones in the electronics category are in stock for product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity 1. If they are, hold the best recommendation for me, confirm that held order, add the confirmed selection to my cart, and generate an invoice with the best available discount using buyer@example.com and Stripe. This is for user_id user_123. After that, save a short note summarizing the purchase and invoice, get the latest business news, then email that note to buyer@example.com — the recipients list is [buyer@example.com] — with a subject saying that my order has been processed. Finally, analyze the text of that note.
